errors.drive_missing: The USB drive holding your data is not connected

storage.not_a_folder: Choose a folder or a drive
storage.drive_has_data: That drive already holds E-Board data. Use it from the sign-in screen instead
storage.already_portable: Your data is already on a drive
storage.already_local: Your data is already on this computer
storage.local_has_data: This computer already has its own E-Board data

missing.title: Insert your USB drive
missing.text: Your E-Board data is kept on a USB drive. Plug it back in and the app opens by itself; nothing is stored on this computer.
missing.local_confirm: Open the data kept on this computer? The drive is not changed.

storage.removed: The drive was removed. Everything was closed and you were signed out.
storage.use_drive: Use data from a USB drive…
storage.use_drive_confirm: Pick the drive (or folder) that holds your E-Board data. If it holds none, new empty data is started there. This computer's own data is not touched. The app restarts.

settings.title: Where your data lives
settings.description: Keep everything on a USB drive so nothing stays on this computer.
settings.to_drive_text: Pick the drive. Everything is copied there, the copy on this computer is erased, and the app restarts. From then on the app only works while the drive is plugged in: pulling it out closes the app and signs you out.
settings.to_local_text: Everything is copied back to this computer and erased from the drive. The app restarts.
settings.working: Moving your data… the app will restart.
settings.warning: Keep the drive safe: anyone who has it has your data. Keep a backup copy of it elsewhere, because a lost or damaged drive cannot be recovered.
